title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Waiver Points for a Slow Determination
content:
A slow determination adds points to the waiver share on Benefit Overpayment Accounts, the delay counted in whole months from the last overpaid week to the determination date. Both dates are read from the overpayment record, the last overpaid week by its week ending date.

| Whole months from the last overpaid week to the determination date | Points added to the waiver share |
|---|---|
| 6 or more (the long-delay months) | 0.1, the long-delay points |
| 2 or more but fewer than 6 (the short-delay months) | 0.05, the short-delay points |
| Fewer than 2 | None |

## Interpretive note

The delay runs from the end of the overpaid period, not from its beginning. A determination issued in the same month as the last overpaid week, or in the month after, earns nothing.

## Hypothetical cases

| Last overpaid week ending | Determination date | Whole months | Points |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 March | 14 September | 6 | 0.1 |
| 14 March | 13 September | 5 | 0.05 |
| 14 March | 14 May | 2 | 0.05 |
| 14 March | 13 May | 1 | None |
